description: Land Acquisition - Matuwagala, Kirella D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette notice is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically deals with the government's intention to acquire a particular piece of land (Lot 392) for public purposes (distribution among disaster victims and village expansion programs). The content focuses entirely on land acquisition procedures, property description, and compensation claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
